goal: Map page part 2: click-to-details side panel, top regions figure, 3D view toggle coloured by the primary numeric (M2b; Board gate 180: Map app 3D colours by the primary numeric by name rule, Explorer map3d unchanged)

acceptance_criteria.text: Clicking a point fills `.map-panel` with a `<dl>` of the row's columns and values (numbers with thousands separators; `rows[customdata]` from the payload, no extra request); clicking a hex cell shows `Points in cell: N`

The panel also holds the top-regions figure (a leaderboard with the same rules as the Business one: orientation h, value labels, Other in --muted as its own trace, no pointer, no click action since drill is False) when the payload has it; absent without a category column

A hidden `<figure data-kind="map3d" hidden>` and a `3D view` button (`aria-pressed`) in the Map head: pressing hides the 2D figure, shows and (first time) draws the map3d chart from the payload (Plotly scatter3d, colour and z title = the primary numeric's name), pressing again shows the 2D map again; 3D uses the same height rule and the camera that avoids clipped titles
Table toggle (ticket G1 part 2) works on the map figure (lon/lat/colour or count columns) and on the regions figure; no yaxis2; every number >= 1,000 in the panel, tooltips and ticks has separators
